text: Warp, then refine: reproject the previous RGB-D frame by head pose, and a tiny net fills only the holes
description: About 90% of pixels come from explicit depth reprojection, so head motion responds instantly at 90 Hz. The network only fills disocclusions, stylises, and lets the world evolve. Related work: Infinite Nature (render, refine, repeat), ASW-style reprojection.
